I'm getting this  message in firestore auth page. What Does it mean:

The following Authentication features will stop working when Firebase Dynamic Links shuts down on August 25, 2025: email link authentication for mobile apps, as well as Cordova OAuth support for web apps.

_**Agent (2025-08-04 19:15:07Z)**_

This Firebase message is a warning about upcoming changes to Firebase Dynamic Links, which will be shutting down on August 25, 2025. Let me break down what this means for your application:

## What's Affected

The shutdown will impact two specific authentication features:
1. **Email link authentication for mobile apps** - When users click email verification links on mobile devices
2. **Cordova OAuth support for web apps** - OAuth authentication in Cordova-based web applications

## What This Means for Your App

Let me check your current authentication setup to see if you're using any of these features:

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const AuthProvider: React.FC\u003cAuthProviderProps\u003e = ({ children }) =\u003e {\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState\u003cUser | null\u003e(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null);\n\n  // Add debugging\n  console.log('[AuthProvider] Initializing...');\n\n  const login = async (email: string, password: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[AuthContext] Attempting login for:', email);\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);\n      console.log('[AuthContext] Login successful for:', email);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('[AuthContext] Login error:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loginWithGoogle = async (): Promise\u003c{ isNewUser: boolean }\u003e =\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[AuthContext] Starting Google sign-in process');\n      \n      // Check if Google Auth is available\n      if (typeof GoogleAuthProvider === 'undefined') {\n        throw new Error('Google authentication is not available. Please enable it in Firebase console.');\n      }\n      \n      const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();\n      \n      // Set custom parameters for better UX\n      provider.setCustomParameters({\n        prompt: 'select_account'\n      });\n      \n      const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);\n      const user = result.user;\n      \n      console.log('[AuthContext] Google sign-in successful for:', user.email);\n      \n      // Check if user profile exists, if not create it\n      const isNewUser = await createUserProfileIfNeeded(user);\n      \n      return { isNewUser };\n      \n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('[AuthContext] Google sign-in error:', error);\n      \n      // Check if the error is due to provider not being enabled\n      if (error.code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') {\n        throw new Error('Google sign-in is not enabled. Please enable it in your Firebase console.');\n      }\n      \n      throw error;\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst LoginPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const { login, loginWithGoogle } = useAuth();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    \n    try {\n      setError('');\n      setLoading(true);\n      await login(email, password);\n      \n      // Check if email is verified\n      const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n      if (currentUser \u0026\u0026 !currentUser.emailVerified) {\n        navigate('/verify-email');\n      } else {\n        navigate('/');\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('Login error details:', err);\n      if (err.code === 'auth/user-not-found') {\n        setError('No account found with this email address');\n      } else if (err.code === 'auth/wrong-password') {\n        setError('Incorrect password. Please try again.');\n      } else if (err.code === 'auth/too-many-requests') {\n        setError('Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.');\n      } else if (err.code === 'auth/invalid-email') {\n        setError('Invalid email address format.');\n      } else if (err.code === 'auth/user-disabled') {\n        setError('This account has been disabled. Please contact support.');\n      } else if (err.code === 'auth/invalid-credential') {\n        setError('Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.');\n      } else {\n        setError(&#96;Login failed: ${err.message || 'Please try again.'}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport { auth, db } from '../firebase';\nimport { \n  User, \n  signInWithEmailAndPassword, \n  createUserWithEmailAndPassword, \n  signOut,\n  updateProfile,\n  GoogleAuthProvider,\n  signInWithPopup,\n  OAuthProvider,\n  deleteUser,\n  reauthenticateWithCredential,\n  EmailAuthProvider,\n  sendEmailVerification,\n  sendPasswordResetEmail\n} from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { doc, setDoc, serverTimestamp, getDoc, writeBatch, collection, query, where, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';\n\ninterface AuthContextType {\n  currentUser: User | null;\n  loading: boolean;\n  userProfile: any | null;\n  login: (email: string, password: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  signup: (email: string, password: string, firstName?: string, lastName?: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  loginWithGoogle: () =\u003e Promise\u003c{ isNewUser: boolean }\u003e;\n  logout: () =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  deleteAccount: (password?: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  sendEmailVerification: () =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  sendPasswordReset: (email: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n  resendVerificationEmail: () =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n}",

        "originalContents": "// src/components/Login.tsx\n\n// test comment\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { auth } from '../firebase';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst Login: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { loginWithGoogle } = useAuth();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (loading) return; // Prevent double submission\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError('');\n\n    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();\n    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();\n\n    if (!trimmedEmail || !trimmedPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailPasswordRequired'));\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, trimmedEmail, trimmedPassword);\n      navigate('/');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error);\n      setError(\n        error.code === 'auth/user-not-found' || error.code === 'auth/wrong-password'\n          ? t('auth.errors.invalidCredentials')\n          : error.code === 'auth/too-many-requests'\n          ? t('auth.errors.tooManyRequests')\n          : t('auth.errors.loginError')\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",
